name: Customer Payment Report
sql_query:
SELECT receipt_date, receipt_no, receipt_type, customer_code, customer_name, reference,
       cash, card, cheque, bank_transfer, cash + card + cheque + bank_transfer AS total
FROM (
    -- Paid at the time of a sales invoice
    SELECT s.Invoice_date AS receipt_date, s.Invoice_no AS receipt_no, 'Sales Payment' AS receipt_type,
           s.customer_code, COALESCE(c.name, s.Customer_Name) AS customer_name, s.Invoice_no AS reference,
           s.Cash_Pay AS cash, s.card_payment AS card, s.Cheque AS cheque, s.bank_transfer
    FROM t_invoice_sums s
    LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.Code = s.customer_code
    WHERE s.BC = :bc AND s.Invoice_date BETWEEN :from AND :to
      AND s.Cash_Pay + s.card_payment + s.Cheque + s.bank_transfer > 0

    -- Payments against invoices
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.Payment_date, p.Payment_no, 'Customer Payment',
           c.Code, COALESCE(c.name, p.Customer_Name),
           (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(a.sales_invoice_no SEPARATOR ', ') FROM t_customer_invoice_payments a WHERE a.payment_no = p.Payment_no),
           p.cash_payment, p.card_payment, p.cheque_payment, p.bank_transfer
    FROM t_customer_payments p
    LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.NIC = p.Customer_NIC AND c.BC = p.BC
    WHERE p.BC = :bc AND p.Payment_date BETWEEN :from AND :to

    -- Advance payments
    UNION ALL
    SELECT v.payment_date, v.payment_no, 'Advance Payment',
           c.Code, COALESCE(c.name, v.customer_name), v.payment_note,
           v.cash_payment, v.card_payment, v.cheque_payment, v.bank_transfer
    FROM t_advanc_cus_payments v
    LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.NIC = v.customer_nic AND c.BC = v.BC
    WHERE v.BC = :bc AND v.payment_date BETWEEN :from AND :to

    -- HP down payments (the part not covered by an advance); method taken from the ledger account
    UNION ALL
    SELECT h.invoice_date, CONCAT(h.invoice_no, '-DP'), 'HP Down Payment',
           h.customer_code, COALESCE(c.name, h.customer_name), CONCAT('Agreement ', h.agreement_no),
           IF(g.AccCode = '1001', g.amount, 0), 0,
           IF(g.AccCode = '1102', g.amount, 0),
           IF(g.AccCode NOT IN ('1001', '1102'), g.amount, 0)
    FROM t_hire_purchase_sums h
    JOIN (
        SELECT trance_no, AccCode, dr_amount AS amount
        FROM t_account_trans
        WHERE BC = :bc AND trance_type = 'HP_DOWN_PAYMENT' AND dr_amount > 0
    ) g ON g.trance_no = CONCAT(h.invoice_no, '-DP')
    LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.Code = h.customer_code
    WHERE h.BC = :bc AND h.invoice_date BETWEEN :from AND :to

    -- HP installment collections (one row per collection)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT MIN(p.payment_date), COALESCE(p.collection_no, p.payment_no), 'HP Installment',
           h.customer_code, COALESCE(c.name, h.customer_name), CONCAT('Agreement ', h.agreement_no),
           SUM(IF(p.payment_method = 'cash', p.total_amount, 0)),
           SUM(IF(p.payment_method = 'card', p.total_amount, 0)),
           SUM(IF(p.payment_method = 'cheque', p.total_amount, 0)),
           SUM(IF(p.payment_method = 'bank_transfer', p.total_amount, 0))
    FROM t_hp_installment_payments p
    JOIN t_hire_purchase_sums h ON h.invoice_no = p.invoice_no
    LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.Code = h.customer_code
    WHERE p.BC = :bc AND p.status = 'posted' AND p.payment_date BETWEEN :from AND :to
    GROUP BY COALESCE(p.collection_no, p.payment_no), h.customer_code, c.name, h.customer_name, h.agreement_no

    -- HP converted to a cash sale (settlement)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT t.conversion_date, t.conversion_no, 'HP Cash Conversion',
           h.customer_code, COALESCE(c.name, t.customer_name), CONCAT('Agreement ', t.agreement_no),
           t.cash_payment, t.card_payment, t.cheque_payment, t.bank_transfer
    FROM t_hire_purchase_to_sales t
    JOIN t_hire_purchase_sums h ON h.invoice_no = t.invoice_no
    LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.Code = h.customer_code
    WHERE t.BC = :bc AND t.conversion_date BETWEEN :from AND :to
) receipts
WHERE (:customer     IS NULL OR customer_code = :customer)
  AND (:receipt_type IS NULL OR receipt_type = :receipt_type)
  AND (:payment_method IS NULL
       OR (:payment_method = 'cash'   AND cash > 0)
       OR (:payment_method = 'card'   AND card > 0)
       OR (:payment_method = 'cheque' AND cheque > 0)
       OR (:payment_method = 'bank'   AND bank_transfer > 0))
ORDER BY receipt_date, receipt_no;
